# Orla

> ORLA, Dorchester Collection is an ultra-luxury beachfront residence on the crescent of Palm Jumeirah, arranged as three staggered volumes on a 29,000 square metre beachfront plot. Around 90 homes range from apartments and duplexes to triplexes, a three-storey sky palace and a private beach mansion. A spa, beach club and hotel-style services managed by Dorchester Collection serve the building, which rises fourteen storeys above two basement levels.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Palm Jumeirah, Dubai, UAE
- Status: On-Going

## MENASCO Scope

ORLA is an ultra-luxury beachfront residential development by OMNIYAT on the crescent of Palm Jumeirah, designed by Foster + Partners and managed by Dorchester Collection. The scheme comprises 93 homes, including simplex, duplex and triplex residences, super penthouses, a Sky Palace and a beach mansion. MENASCO is responsible for the MEP works on this signature waterfront project.
